desc:
🧩 Welcome to +1 Cubing Evolution! 🧩

CODES: RELEASE, 40LIKES
NEXT CODE AT 100 LIKES 👍

HOW TO PLAY:
⚡ Step on a training pad and solve to get +1 TPS (turns per second) every tick!
🏃 Walk into the COMPETE ZONE and race real-looking cubers down the Competition Road!
🏆 Beat your rival in each zone to earn Wins. The faster you turn, the further you go!
🧊 Spend Wins on 40 speed cubes, from the Classic Cube all the way to the Infinity Legend!
🔥 Unlock better training rooms for up to x32 training (x64 in the VIP rooms)!
🔁 Rebirth to boost your training forever and climb the leaderboards!
🌆 Reach 20 rebirths to travel to WORLD 2: Neon City, with 15 brand new zones!

Can you beat the Ultimate Champion? 👑

🎁 Claim FREE daily rewards and a FREE gift every few minutes!
💤 Earn TPS even while you’re offline!
👍 LIKE + FAVORITE the game and join the GROUP for rewards
